meta.purpose: Kid-friendly, card-specific visual observations for Illustration Rare, Ultra Rare, Special Illustration Rare, and Hyper Rare cards.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.headline: Pinsir in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Pinsir is shown from behind beneath a tree, looking out across a bright rural landscape of fields and distant mountains. The simple, chunky shapes make the scene feel like a quiet summer postcard rather than a battle.
artwork.story_hook: A tough-looking Pokémon gets a surprisingly peaceful moment to enjoy the view.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Pinsir gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #168/167, an Illustration Rare. It is famous for enormous pincers and remarkable strength, using those horns to grab, lift, and crush opponents. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. A tough-looking Pokémon gets a surprisingly peaceful moment to enjoy the view.

cards.name: Sunflora
cards.headline: Sunflora in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: A cheerful group of Sunflora fills a sunny garden, with a watermelon in the foreground and flowers all around. Cool blue linework against the yellow-green plants makes the whole card feel bright and playful.
artwork.story_hook: The artwork turns Sunflora's love of sunlight into a whole summer-day celebration.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Sunflora gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #169/167, an Illustration Rare. It converts sunlight into energy and becomes much more active in bright daylight, fitting its sunflower-like design perfectly. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The artwork turns Sunflora's love of sunlight into a whole summer-day celebration.

cards.name: Dipplin
cards.headline: Dipplin in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Dipplin appears like the star attraction at a colorful festival sweets stall, surrounded by candy-apple shapes and bright decorations. The scene connects its apple-like design directly to the food and festival atmosphere of Kitakami.
artwork.story_hook: Dipplin almost looks like one of the treats at the stall—which is exactly the joke.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Dipplin gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #170/167, an Illustration Rare. This Kitakami evolution of Applin lives inside a syrup-coated apple and is actually formed by two creatures working together. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. Dipplin almost looks like one of the treats at the stall—which is exactly the joke.

cards.name: Poltchageist
cards.headline: A Haunted Cup of Matcha

artwork.observation: Poltchageist floats in a dim, cluttered room while a curious child investigates nearby. Warm dusty colors, shelves and little objects make it feel more like a tiny supernatural story than a battle card.
artwork.story_hook: It feels as if someone has just discovered that the old tea caddy in the room is alive.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Poltchageist gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #171/167, an Illustration Rare. It resembles Sinistea but is unrelated; it is a matcha-based Ghost Pokémon said to have formed from the regrets of a tea master. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. It feels as if someone has just discovered that the old tea caddy in the room is alive.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.headline: Torkoal in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Torkoal is worked into a pottery workshop scene, its heat fitting naturally beside kilns, pots and an older craftsperson at work. Earthy browns and smoke make the Pokémon feel like part of the workshop itself.
artwork.story_hook: Torkoal's coal-and-smoke biology becomes useful craft heat instead of just an attack.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Torkoal gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #172/167, an Illustration Rare. It burns coal inside its shell and releases smoke from its nostrils and back, with the smoke revealing how healthy it is. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. Torkoal's coal-and-smoke biology becomes useful craft heat instead of just an attack.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.headline: Infernape in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Infernape fills the card in an explosive close-up, surrounded by whipping flames and flashes of blue from its hands and face. The tight crop makes the image feel fast, loud and almost too energetic to stay inside the frame.
artwork.story_hook: This is Infernape at full blast—the picture feels like the instant before a huge attack lands.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Infernape gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #173/167, an Illustration Rare. Inspired by the Monkey King, it combines acrobatics, martial arts, and blazing punches in a fast, aggressive fighting style. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. This is Infernape at full blast—the picture feels like the instant before a huge attack lands.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.headline: Froslass in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Froslass stands in a shadowy traditional-looking setting while streaks of colored light cut across the darker background. The contrast makes its pale body look especially ghostlike and gives the scene an eerie, elegant atmosphere.
artwork.story_hook: The card leans into the idea that Froslass is as much a ghost story as an Ice Pokémon.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Froslass gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #174/167, an Illustration Rare. Inspired by the Japanese yuki-onna snow spirit, it is associated with icy mountains and eerie frozen victims. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The card leans into the idea that Froslass is as much a ghost story as an Ice Pokémon.

cards.name: Phione
cards.headline: Phione in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Phione drifts beneath softly lit blue-green waves, with other Phione shapes disappearing into the water around it. The gentle light and huge sense of water make the little Pokémon feel peaceful and weightless.
artwork.story_hook: Instead of showing an attack, the card lets Phione simply float the way it does in its lore.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Phione gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #175/167, an Illustration Rare. A small sea-dwelling Mythical Pokémon that drifts in warm oceans and can always return to its birthplace. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. Instead of showing an attack, the card lets Phione simply float the way it does in its lore.

cards.name: Cramorant
cards.headline: Cramorant in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Cramorant stands sharply in focus while the world behind it dissolves into soft pastel blobs and busy color. Its blank, slightly bewildered expression makes the pretty background feel like part of the joke.
artwork.story_hook: Cramorant manages to look completely serious while everything around it feels hilariously chaotic.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Cramorant gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #176/167, an Illustration Rare. Its Gulp Missile gimmick has it dive for prey and sometimes return with something far more surprising than a fish. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. Cramorant manages to look completely serious while everything around it feels hilariously chaotic.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.headline: Heliolisk in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Heliolisk splashes through sunlit wet grass with droplets flying around it, while a smaller Helioptile can be spotted in the background. Strong diagonal motion and bright green light make the scene feel hot, wet and energetic.
artwork.story_hook: A sunlight-loving Pokémon gets an artwork full of glare, water and movement.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Heliolisk gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #177/167, an Illustration Rare. Its solar-powered frills can generate impressive amounts of electricity, matching its desert-lizard inspiration. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. A sunlight-loving Pokémon gets an artwork full of glare, water and movement.

cards.name: Wattrel
cards.headline: Wattrel in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Wattrel dives underwater through foamy blue surf, surrounded by smaller birds and thin crackling lines of electricity. Seeing an Electric bird beneath the waves gives the card a surprising sense of speed and danger.
artwork.story_hook: The unusual underwater angle makes this tiny coastal bird feel like a diving torpedo.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Wattrel gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #178/167, an Illustration Rare. A seabird Pokémon that uses wind and its wings to generate electricity while flying over the ocean. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The unusual underwater angle makes this tiny coastal bird feel like a diving torpedo.

cards.name: Chimecho
cards.headline: Chimecho in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Chimecho hangs among colorful wind chimes in soft daylight, almost blending into the decorations around it. The shallow focus and gentle movement make this one of the quieter, more peaceful illustrations in the set.
artwork.story_hook: You have to look twice to spot which hanging chime is actually the Pokémon.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Chimecho gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #179/167, an Illustration Rare. It creates sound by vibrating its body and uses its long tail to hang from branches or structures. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. You have to look twice to spot which hanging chime is actually the Pokémon.

cards.name: Enamorus
cards.headline: Enamorus in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Enamorus dominates a graphic field of pinks, hearts, sparkles and curling lines. The design is more like a bold poster than a landscape, turning its love-themed mythology into the entire visual language of the card.
artwork.story_hook: Everything in the picture—from the palette to the shapes—echoes Enamorus's connection with love.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Enamorus gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #180/167, an Illustration Rare. A Legendary Pokémon associated with spring; its arrival is said to signal the end of harsh winter weather. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. Everything in the picture—from the palette to the shapes—echoes Enamorus's connection with love.

cards.name: Hisuian Growlithe
cards.headline: Hisuian Growlithe in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Hisuian Growlithe bounds happily through glowing green-gold woodland, framed by the legs and shoes of people just outside the main action. The low viewpoint makes it feel as if the little Growlithe is running straight toward you.
artwork.story_hook: The card feels like a happy snapshot from a walk rather than a posed Pokémon portrait.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Hisuian Growlithe gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #181/167, an Illustration Rare. This regional Growlithe has thick fur and a rocky horn, adaptations suited to the colder Hisui region. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The card feels like a happy snapshot from a walk rather than a posed Pokémon portrait.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.headline: Probopass in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Probopass sits like a strange public sculpture in the middle of a lively city plaza, surrounded by pedestrians, birds and everyday street activity. The deadpan placement of such an odd Pokémon makes the whole scene wonderfully funny.
artwork.story_hook: Everyone is going about their day while a giant magnetic nose-shaped Pokémon quietly owns the plaza.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Probopass gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #182/167, an Illustration Rare. It controls three small magnetic units called Mini-Noses and uses magnetism to attack and navigate. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. Everyone is going about their day while a giant magnetic nose-shaped Pokémon quietly owns the plaza.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.headline: Timburr in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Timburr is hard at work on a busy construction site, swinging and carrying lumber while workers, tools and stacked materials fill the background. Its wooden beam finally looks less like a weapon and more like the tool it was born to use.
artwork.story_hook: The illustration shows what Timburr might actually do when nobody is battling.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Timburr gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #183/167, an Illustration Rare. It always carries a wooden beam and uses it both for training and for construction work. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The illustration shows what Timburr might actually do when nobody is battling.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.headline: Lairon in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Lairon explores a cluttered scrapyard or workshop packed with pipes, tools, bolts and discarded metal. Its armored body blends naturally into the industrial mess, almost like another piece of machinery.
artwork.story_hook: A Steel Pokémon hiding among metal scraps is a perfect visual camouflage trick.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Lairon gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #184/167, an Illustration Rare. It lives in mountains rich in iron and fiercely defends feeding territory from rivals. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. A Steel Pokémon hiding among metal scraps is a perfect visual camouflage trick.

cards.name: Applin
cards.headline: Applin in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: A large apple tree is loaded with fruit—and several Applin are hiding among the apples, peeking out from branches and baskets. The countryside backdrop turns the Pokémon's apple disguise into a playful hide-and-seek picture.
artwork.story_hook: Count the apples carefully: some of them are looking back at you.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Applin gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #185/167, an Illustration Rare. A tiny dragon that hides inside an apple, borrowing the fruit as both shelter and disguise. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. Count the apples carefully: some of them are looking back at you.

cards.name: Tatsugiri
cards.headline: Tiny Sushi, Big Brain

artwork.observation: Multiple Tatsugiri forms repeat across a bright blue background in a bold pop-art pattern. Thick outlines and repeated poses make it feel more like a playful poster or fabric print than a traditional Pokémon scene.
artwork.story_hook: The different Tatsugiri forms become the pattern itself, so the whole card celebrates their variety.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Tatsugiri gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #186/167, an Illustration Rare. A tiny sushi-like Dragon Pokémon that is extremely intelligent and forms a famous partnership with Dondozo. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The different Tatsugiri forms become the pattern itself, so the whole card celebrates their variety.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.headline: Chansey in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Chansey carries a tall stack of parcels through a busy Pokémon Center while Blissey works behind the counter, Snorlax sleeps nearby and other Pokémon fill the room. There are tiny background jokes everywhere you look.
artwork.story_hook: This card rewards a second look because the background is packed with little Pokémon Center stories.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Chansey gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #187/167, an Illustration Rare. Known for kindness and healing, it carries a nutritious egg and often shares it with injured people or Pokémon. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. This card rewards a second look because the background is packed with little Pokémon Center stories.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.headline: The Evolution Pokémon

artwork.observation: Eight Eevee lounge, play and tumble around a warm, sunlit home filled with cushions, books, plants and flowers. The soft watercolor look makes the room feel wonderfully cozy—and gives every Eevee a slightly different personality.
artwork.story_hook: Instead of one Eevee portrait, the card gives you a whole houseful of them to discover.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Eevee gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #188/167, an Illustration Rare. Its unstable genetic structure lets it evolve into many different forms, making it the symbol of branching evolution in Pokémon. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. Instead of one Eevee portrait, the card gives you a whole houseful of them to discover.

cards.name: Sinistcha ex
cards.headline: Tea with a Ghostly Twist

artwork.observation: Sinistcha receives a clean full-art showcase: its teacup-like body and curling green ghostly tea are enlarged against a stylized green background. With little scenery to distract from it, the unusual shape of the Pokémon becomes the main attraction.
artwork.story_hook: The Ultra Rare treatment turns Sinistcha's strange tea-spirit silhouette into the whole composition.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Sinistcha gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #189/167, an Ultra Rare. The evolution of Poltchageist lives in a fine teacup and builds energy by stirring with the tea whisk on its head. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The Ultra Rare treatment turns Sinistcha's strange tea-spirit silhouette into the whole composition.

cards.name: Teal Mask Ogerpon ex
cards.headline: The Face of Kitakami

artwork.observation: Teal Mask Ogerpon ex is presented as a bright green full-art portrait with its mask pushed right to the visual foreground. Crystalline Tera shapes and saturated green details make the mask feel almost jewel-like.
artwork.story_hook: On this print, the Teal Mask is not just an accessory—it becomes the star of the card.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Teal Mask Ogerpon gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #190/167, an Ultra Rare. Ogerpon is the central Legendary Pokémon of Kitakami’s Teal Mask story, and this mask represents its natural Grass-type form. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. On this print, the Teal Mask is not just an accessory—it becomes the star of the card.

cards.name: Magcargo ex
cards.headline: Magcargo in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Magcargo ex fills the full-art frame with its molten body and huge shell, surrounded by hot red-orange graphic effects. The stripped-back background makes the Pokémon look even hotter and heavier.
artwork.story_hook: The full-art treatment turns Magcargo into a walking piece of lava.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Magcargo gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #191/167, an Ultra Rare. Its shell is hardened magma, while the inside remains incredibly hot—one of the most volcanically themed Pokémon in the series. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The full-art treatment turns Magcargo into a walking piece of lava.

cards.name: Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon ex
cards.headline: Ogerpon’s Fiery Mask

artwork.observation: Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon ex uses a fiery red-orange full-art treatment with the mask and crystalline Tera details pushed forward. It feels sharper and more aggressive than the green Teal Mask version.
artwork.story_hook: Changing the mask changes the whole mood: this Ogerpon looks ready to charge straight into battle.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #192/167, an Ultra Rare. With the Hearthflame Mask, Ogerpon takes on a fiery Grass/Fire form associated with a fierce, aggressive fighting style. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. Changing the mask changes the whole mood: this Ogerpon looks ready to charge straight into battle.

cards.name: Palafin ex
cards.headline: A Secret Superhero

artwork.observation: Palafin ex gets a superhero-like full-art presentation, with its powerful transformed body dominating a blue-purple graphic background. The pose makes the comic-book inspiration behind Hero Form especially obvious.
artwork.story_hook: Palafin's secret superhero idea becomes much easier to see when the card gives it the whole frame.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Palafin gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #193/167, an Ultra Rare. Its ordinary Zero Form hides a superhero transformation: after switching out in battle, it returns as the dramatically stronger Hero Form. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. Palafin's secret superhero idea becomes much easier to see when the card gives it the whole frame.

cards.name: Wellspring Mask Ogerpon ex
cards.headline: Ogerpon of the Wellspring

artwork.observation: Wellspring Mask Ogerpon ex is shown in a cool blue crystalline composition, with the mask centered among faceted Tera shapes. The watery palette makes this version feel calmer and more fluid than the Hearthflame print.
artwork.story_hook: The same Ogerpon feels completely different when the mask, palette and element switch to water.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Wellspring Mask Ogerpon gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #194/167, an Ultra Rare. The Wellspring Mask changes Ogerpon into a Grass/Water form, connecting it with flowing water and a more graceful battle style. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The same Ogerpon feels completely different when the mask, palette and element switch to water.

cards.name: Luxray ex
cards.headline: Luxray in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Luxray ex is enlarged against an electric full-art backdrop where sharp blue, black and yellow shapes echo its fur and lightning theme. The design has the feel of a bold electric poster.
artwork.story_hook: Luxray's spiky silhouette and lightning colors do most of the storytelling here.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Luxray gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #195/167, an Ultra Rare. Its extraordinary eyesight can see through solid objects, helping it locate hidden prey or missing young. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. Luxray's spiky silhouette and lightning colors do most of the storytelling here.

cards.name: Iron Thorns ex
cards.headline: Iron Thorns in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Iron Thorns ex gets a futuristic full-art treatment with hard geometric forms and vivid green technological accents. The sparse setting makes its mechanical, almost weapon-like silhouette especially striking.
artwork.story_hook: The card looks less like a wild creature portrait and more like a machine powering up.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Iron Thorns gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #196/167, an Ultra Rare. A futuristic Paradox Pokémon resembling Tyranitar, covered in angular armor and glowing green elements. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The card looks less like a wild creature portrait and more like a machine powering up.

cards.name: Scream Tail ex
cards.headline: Scream Tail in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Scream Tail ex fills a vivid pink-magenta full-art background, with its enormous hair and round eyes giving the design an intentionally strange prehistoric-cute look. The simple backdrop lets that bizarre silhouette do all the work.
artwork.story_hook: It looks cute for about half a second—then you notice just how enormous that tail of hair really is.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Scream Tail gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #197/167, an Ultra Rare. An ancient Paradox Pokémon resembling Jigglypuff but with fangs, wild hair, and a much more feral appearance. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. It looks cute for about half a second—then you notice just how enormous that tail of hair really is.

cards.name: Greninja ex
cards.headline: Greninja in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Greninja ex appears in a sharp crystalline Tera full-art design, with angular facets and intense color around the ninja-like pose. Compared with the regular card, the premium treatment makes it feel more like a jewel-covered action figure.
artwork.story_hook: The familiar stealthy ninja suddenly becomes one of the flashiest Pokémon in the set.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Greninja gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #198/167, an Ultra Rare. A ninja-inspired Pokémon that creates sharp water weapons and moves with exceptional speed and stealth. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The familiar stealthy ninja suddenly becomes one of the flashiest Pokémon in the set.

cards.name: Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon ex
cards.headline: Ogerpon Stands Like Stone

artwork.observation: Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon ex uses an earthy, stone-colored full-art treatment with broad angular forms around the mask. The composition feels heavier and more solid than the other Ogerpon masks.
artwork.story_hook: The rocky mask makes this Ogerpon feel less like a dancer and more like a little fortress.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #199/167, an Ultra Rare. The Cornerstone Mask gives Ogerpon a Grass/Rock form built around toughness, defense, and a stone-like stance. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The rocky mask makes this Ogerpon feel less like a dancer and more like a little fortress.

cards.name: Dragapult ex
cards.headline: Dragapult in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Dragapult ex stretches across a sleek full-art composition with ghostly teal and dark tones emphasizing its long, aerodynamic shape. The premium portrait makes its odd combination of dragon, ghost and living launcher look especially futuristic.
artwork.story_hook: Few Pokémon have a silhouette as strange as Dragapult, and the full art gives that shape room to fly.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Dragapult gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #200/167, an Ultra Rare. It launches the Dreepy living in its horn-like head openings at high speed—apparently with the Dreepy enjoying the ride. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. Few Pokémon have a silhouette as strange as Dragapult, and the full art gives that shape room to fly.

cards.name: Blissey ex
cards.headline: Blissey in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Blissey ex is given a bright pink full-art portrait with its round body and cheerful expression front and center. The premium treatment is simple, friendly and deliberately very different from the darker chase cards around it.
artwork.story_hook: Not every rare card needs to look fierce—Blissey's whole superpower is looking reassuring.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Blissey gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #201/167, an Ultra Rare. The evolved form of Chansey is strongly associated with compassion and healing, and its egg is said to make people feel happier. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. Not every rare card needs to look fierce—Blissey's whole superpower is looking reassuring.

cards.name: Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex
cards.headline: The Bloodmoon Beast

artwork.observation: Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex gets a bold full-art close-up where its huge body and distinctive red moon marking dominate the frame. The simpler premium background makes the Bloodmoon feature impossible to miss.
artwork.story_hook: The red moon mark is the visual clue that this is not an ordinary Ursaluna.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Bloodmoon Ursaluna gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #202/167, an Ultra Rare. The mysterious “Bloodmoon Beast” is a unique Ursaluna found in Kitakami, marked by a red moon-like feature on its forehead and the signature move Blood Moon. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The red moon mark is the visual clue that this is not an ordinary Ursaluna.

cards.name: Caretaker
cards.headline: Caretaker in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Caretaker receives the classic Supporter Ultra Rare treatment: a full-body character portrait with a simplified decorative background. With the scenery removed, clothing, pose and expression become the details collectors notice first.
artwork.story_hook: Trainer Ultra Rares work almost like character posters—the person, not the setting, is the story.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: A Supporter representing one of the adults connected with Blueberry Academy and the wider Scarlet & Violet school setting. This #203/167 print is an Ultra Rare, giving Caretaker an extra collector-focused showcase in Twilight Masquerade. Trainer Ultra Rares work almost like character posters—the person, not the setting, is the story.

cards.name: Carmine
cards.headline: Kitakami’s Fierce Big Sister

artwork.observation: Carmine is presented in a confident full-body Trainer portrait with a warm, energetic color treatment. It is a cleaner character showcase than her later Special Illustration Rare, which puts her back into the festival world.
artwork.story_hook: This print is the 'character poster' Carmine; #217 is the little story scene.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: A major character from The Teal Mask. She is Kieran’s older sister: proud, competitive, and deeply connected to Kitakami. This #204/167 print is an Ultra Rare, giving Carmine an extra collector-focused showcase in Twilight Masquerade. This print is the 'character poster' Carmine; #217 is the little story scene.

cards.name: Hassel
cards.headline: Hassel in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Hassel gets a full-body Supporter portrait that lets his expressive pose and distinctive teacher-and-artist look carry the image. The decorative backdrop keeps the focus squarely on the character.
artwork.story_hook: Hassel is a character who wears his emotions openly, and a full-art portrait suits him perfectly.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: An Elite Four member and art teacher from Paldea, known for his dramatic personality and deep love of art. This #205/167 print is an Ultra Rare, giving Hassel an extra collector-focused showcase in Twilight Masquerade. Hassel is a character who wears his emotions openly, and a full-art portrait suits him perfectly.

cards.name: Kieran
cards.headline: The Boy Who Idolized Ogerpon

artwork.observation: Kieran appears in a clean full-body Trainer composition, with his posture and darker clothing standing out against the simplified background. It feels more reserved and character-focused than his festival SIR at #218.
artwork.story_hook: The two rare Kieran cards tell different stories: this one introduces the character; the SIR catches a moment from his world.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: A central character in The Teal Mask whose admiration for Ogerpon becomes a major part of his personal story and rivalry with the player. This #206/167 print is an Ultra Rare, giving Kieran an extra collector-focused showcase in Twilight Masquerade. The two rare Kieran cards tell different stories: this one introduces the character; the SIR catches a moment from his world.

cards.name: Lana's Aid
cards.headline: Lana's Aid in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Lana's Aid becomes a bright full-art Trainer card that centers Lana and her friendly, slightly quirky personality. The uncluttered treatment makes the character design read instantly even at small app size.
artwork.story_hook: This is the poster-style Lana card; the SIR later adds Corphish and much more comedy.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: A Supporter featuring Lana, the Water-type Trial Captain from Alola, returning here as a useful recovery-themed Trainer card. This #207/167 print is an Ultra Rare, giving Lana's Aid an extra collector-focused showcase in Twilight Masquerade. This is the poster-style Lana card; the SIR later adds Corphish and much more comedy.

cards.name: Lucian
cards.headline: Lucian in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Lucian is shown as a polished full-body Supporter portrait, with a composed pose and restrained background that fit his intellectual Elite Four image. It is more character study than action scene.
artwork.story_hook: A quiet, composed full art fits a character famous for winning with strategy rather than noise.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: A Psychic-type Elite Four member from Sinnoh, recognizable for his calm, scholarly personality and love of reading. This #208/167 print is an Ultra Rare, giving Lucian an extra collector-focused showcase in Twilight Masquerade. A quiet, composed full art fits a character famous for winning with strategy rather than noise.

cards.name: Perrin
cards.headline: Hunting the Bloodmoon Beast

artwork.observation: Perrin gets a full-body Trainer portrait that makes her camera gear and photographer identity easy to read immediately. It acts almost like the cover image before the SIR at #220 shows her actually taking a photograph.
artwork.story_hook: This card tells you Perrin is a photographer; #220 shows you what that looks like in action.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: A photographer introduced in The Teal Mask who asks the player to help photograph rare Pokémon and is closely linked to the Bloodmoon Ursaluna quest. This #209/167 print is an Ultra Rare, giving Perrin an extra collector-focused showcase in Twilight Masquerade. This card tells you Perrin is a photographer; #220 shows you what that looks like in action.

cards.name: Sinistcha ex
cards.headline: Tea with a Ghostly Twist

artwork.observation: Sinistcha inhabits a warm, cluttered room filled with books, notes and tea utensils, turning the card into a tiny lived-in study rather than a monster portrait. Greens and browns make the ghostly tea Pokémon feel strangely at home among ordinary objects.
artwork.story_hook: The fun is spotting how naturally a supernatural cup of tea fits into a messy human room.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Sinistcha gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #210/167, a Special Illustration Rare. The evolution of Poltchageist lives in a fine teacup and builds energy by stirring with the tea whisk on its head. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The fun is spotting how naturally a supernatural cup of tea fits into a messy human room.

cards.name: Teal Mask Ogerpon ex
cards.headline: The Face of Kitakami

artwork.observation: Teal Mask Ogerpon ex rushes forward in a mask-centered composition packed with saturated greens, teals and sharp high-contrast shapes. The image feels like a burst of festival energy rather than a posed portrait.
artwork.story_hook: The mask seems to leap out first, making Ogerpon feel playful and powerful at the same time.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Teal Mask Ogerpon gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #211/167, a Special Illustration Rare. Ogerpon is the central Legendary Pokémon of Kitakami’s Teal Mask story, and this mask represents its natural Grass-type form. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The mask seems to leap out first, making Ogerpon feel playful and powerful at the same time.

cards.name: Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon ex
cards.headline: Ogerpon’s Fiery Mask

artwork.observation: Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon ex turns the four-card Ogerpon SIR idea fiery: red-orange energy and hard, lively shapes surround the flame-themed mask. It is the hottest and most aggressive-looking member of the quartet.
artwork.story_hook: Put the four Ogerpon SIRs together and this is the one that feels like the bonfire has just flared up.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #212/167, a Special Illustration Rare. With the Hearthflame Mask, Ogerpon takes on a fiery Grass/Fire form associated with a fierce, aggressive fighting style. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. Put the four Ogerpon SIRs together and this is the one that feels like the bonfire has just flared up.

cards.name: Wellspring Mask Ogerpon ex
cards.headline: Ogerpon of the Wellspring

artwork.observation: Wellspring Mask Ogerpon ex uses cooler blues and flowing shapes around its water-themed mask, giving the same character a more fluid, graceful feeling. It works as a visual counterpoint to the fiery Hearthflame card.
artwork.story_hook: The four masks are almost a color-and-mood lesson: this one feels like water in motion.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Wellspring Mask Ogerpon gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #213/167, a Special Illustration Rare. The Wellspring Mask changes Ogerpon into a Grass/Water form, connecting it with flowing water and a more graceful battle style. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The four masks are almost a color-and-mood lesson: this one feels like water in motion.

cards.name: Greninja ex
cards.headline: Greninja in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Greninja ex explodes through swirling bands of saturated color that resemble splashed ink, paint and water at once. The Japanese printmaking/ink-painting influence is mixed with neon color, creating one of the set's most immediately recognizable action images.
artwork.story_hook: It looks as if a traditional ink painting suddenly learned how to do a ninja special effect.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Greninja gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #214/167, a Special Illustration Rare. A ninja-inspired Pokémon that creates sharp water weapons and moves with exceptional speed and stealth. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. It looks as if a traditional ink painting suddenly learned how to do a ninja special effect.

cards.name: Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon ex
cards.headline: Ogerpon Stands Like Stone

artwork.observation: Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon ex closes the Ogerpon SIR quartet with earthier tones and heavier angular shapes. The mask feels carved and monument-like, giving the small Pokémon a surprisingly sturdy, grounded presence.
artwork.story_hook: Where the other masks dance with leaves, fire or water, this one feels built to stand its ground.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #215/167, a Special Illustration Rare. The Cornerstone Mask gives Ogerpon a Grass/Rock form built around toughness, defense, and a stone-like stance. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. Where the other masks dance with leaves, fire or water, this one feels built to stand its ground.

cards.name: Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex
cards.headline: The Bloodmoon Beast

artwork.observation: Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex is placed in a quiet moonlit scene with soft, muted painterly colors. The huge bear feels calm rather than attacking, while the red moon marking on its forehead quietly echoes the celestial atmosphere around it.
artwork.story_hook: The art makes the 'Bloodmoon Beast' feel like a legendary animal glimpsed at night, not just a powerful battler.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Bloodmoon Ursaluna gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #216/167, a Special Illustration Rare. The mysterious “Bloodmoon Beast” is a unique Ursaluna found in Kitakami, marked by a red moon-like feature on its forehead and the signature move Blood Moon. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The art makes the 'Bloodmoon Beast' feel like a legendary animal glimpsed at night, not just a powerful battler.

cards.name: Carmine
cards.headline: Kitakami’s Fierce Big Sister

artwork.observation: Carmine is caught in a warm festival-at-night moment, holding a candy apple while soft lights glow behind her. The close, candid framing makes it feel like a photograph from the Festival of Masks rather than a formal Trainer portrait.
artwork.story_hook: Compared with #204, this is not 'Carmine posing for a card'—it feels like you happened to meet her at the festival.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: A major character from The Teal Mask. She is Kieran’s older sister: proud, competitive, and deeply connected to Kitakami. This #217/167 print is a Special Illustration Rare, giving Carmine an extra collector-focused showcase in Twilight Masquerade. Compared with #204, this is not 'Carmine posing for a card'—it feels like you happened to meet her at the festival.

cards.name: Kieran
cards.headline: The Boy Who Idolized Ogerpon

artwork.observation: Kieran appears at the festival in a softer, unguarded moment, with candy apples and warm evening light helping the scene feel personal rather than competitive. Background festival-goers blur away so the focus stays on his expression.
artwork.story_hook: This rare card shows the quieter Kieran from before the story becomes much more intense.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: A central character in The Teal Mask whose admiration for Ogerpon becomes a major part of his personal story and rivalry with the player. This #218/167 print is a Special Illustration Rare, giving Kieran an extra collector-focused showcase in Twilight Masquerade. This rare card shows the quieter Kieran from before the story becomes much more intense.

cards.name: Lana's Aid
cards.headline: Lana's Aid in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Lana and Corphish share a wonderfully silly moment, with their wide-eyed expressions visually echoing each other. The full scene is built around personality and comedy instead of making the Supporter look glamorous or heroic.
artwork.story_hook: The best detail is that Trainer and Pokémon somehow manage to make the same face.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: A Supporter featuring Lana, the Water-type Trial Captain from Alola, returning here as a useful recovery-themed Trainer card. This #219/167 print is a Special Illustration Rare, giving Lana's Aid an extra collector-focused showcase in Twilight Masquerade. The best detail is that Trainer and Pokémon somehow manage to make the same face.

cards.name: Perrin
cards.headline: Hunting the Bloodmoon Beast

artwork.observation: Perrin raises her camera in bright green-gold foliage to photograph Hisuian Growlithe, creating a card about the act of making a picture. It pairs especially well with Growlithe #181, so the two artworks feel like connected snapshots from the same outing.
artwork.story_hook: This is a Pokémon card about a photographer taking a Pokémon picture—and another card in the set gives Growlithe its own side of the adventure.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: A photographer introduced in The Teal Mask who asks the player to help photograph rare Pokémon and is closely linked to the Bloodmoon Ursaluna quest. This #220/167 print is a Special Illustration Rare, giving Perrin an extra collector-focused showcase in Twilight Masquerade. This is a Pokémon card about a photographer taking a Pokémon picture—and another card in the set gives Growlithe its own side of the adventure.

cards.name: Teal Mask Ogerpon ex
cards.headline: The Face of Kitakami

artwork.observation: Teal Mask Ogerpon ex is stripped down into the set's gold Hyper Rare treatment: the Pokémon and mask become a gleaming etched centerpiece against metallic-looking gold patterning. The result feels more like a trophy version of the card than a story scene.
artwork.story_hook: This is the same Teal Mask Ogerpon turned into the collecting equivalent of a gold medal.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Teal Mask Ogerpon gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #221/167, a Hyper Rare. Ogerpon is the central Legendary Pokémon of Kitakami’s Teal Mask story, and this mask represents its natural Grass-type form. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. This is the same Teal Mask Ogerpon turned into the collecting equivalent of a gold medal.

cards.name: Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex
cards.headline: The Bloodmoon Beast

artwork.observation: Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex receives a dramatic gold Hyper Rare makeover, with the massive bear and its moon marking defined through metallic-looking linework and pattern. It is intentionally flashy compared with the quiet, painterly SIR at #216.
artwork.story_hook: The SIR whispers 'mysterious beast'; the gold card shouts 'treasure'.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: Bloodmoon Ursaluna gets a collector spotlight in Twilight Masquerade as #222/167, a Hyper Rare. The mysterious “Bloodmoon Beast” is a unique Ursaluna found in Kitakami, marked by a red moon-like feature on its forehead and the signature move Blood Moon. The special print gives this Pokémon an extra showcase beyond its regular set appearance. The SIR whispers 'mysterious beast'; the gold card shouts 'treasure'.

cards.name: Buddy-Buddy Poffin
cards.headline: Buddy-Buddy Poffin in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Buddy-Buddy Poffin becomes a gold collectible object, with the little snack item isolated and surrounded by ornate metallic-looking patterning. Turning an everyday Trainer item into something that looks precious is part of the joke and charm of Hyper Rares.
artwork.story_hook: A tiny Pokémon snack has somehow been promoted to treasure-chest status.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: A popular Item for setting up small Basic Pokémon early, themed after the Poffins used as Pokémon treats in Sinnoh. This #223/167 print is a Hyper Rare, giving Buddy-Buddy Poffin an extra collector-focused showcase in Twilight Masquerade. A tiny Pokémon snack has somehow been promoted to treasure-chest status.

cards.name: Enhanced Hammer
cards.headline: Enhanced Hammer in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Enhanced Hammer is rendered like a golden prize, with the familiar Tool shape picked out in metallic-looking lines and a patterned gold background. The utilitarian object suddenly looks absurdly expensive.
artwork.story_hook: It is still a hammer—just one that now looks as if it belongs in a royal vault.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: A returning disruptive Item with a long TCG history; its identity is all about removing troublesome Special Energy. This #224/167 print is a Hyper Rare, giving Enhanced Hammer an extra collector-focused showcase in Twilight Masquerade. It is still a hammer—just one that now looks as if it belongs in a royal vault.

cards.name: Rescue Board
cards.headline: Rescue Board in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Rescue Board gets the same gold Hyper Rare spotlight, turning a practical Trainer Tool into a polished icon against etched metallic-looking patterning. Its simple silhouette reads very clearly in the monochrome treatment.
artwork.story_hook: The gold treatment makes even emergency equipment look like a collector's trophy.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: A Pokémon Tool built around making a Pokémon easier to retreat, especially when it has taken damage. This #225/167 print is a Hyper Rare, giving Rescue Board an extra collector-focused showcase in Twilight Masquerade. The gold treatment makes even emergency equipment look like a collector's trophy.

cards.name: Luminous Energy
cards.headline: Luminous Energy in the Spotlight

artwork.observation: Luminous Energy closes the secret-card run with a gold treatment built around the Energy symbol and radiating metallic-looking pattern. Because there is no character or scene, the design leans fully into symmetry, glow and collectible shine.
artwork.story_hook: It looks less like fuel for a Pokémon and more like a tiny golden power source.

cards.card_of_the_day_with_art: A flexible Special Energy that can provide different Energy types, but with restrictions that reward careful deck building. This #226/167 print is a Hyper Rare, giving Luminous Energy an extra collector-focused showcase in Twilight Masquerade. It looks less like fuel for a Pokémon and more like a tiny golden power source.
